title: farmers+
description: A modpack that adds what Mojang forgot to put into Minecraft farming, with lots of new plants, items, and more.
body:
Farmers+ adds lots of new features, including
1. [ Farmer’s Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) (new plants, food types and many other blocks)
2. [RightClickHarvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest) (lets you replant crops and harvest when right clicked using a hoe makes the effert larger) 
3. [The Block Keeps Ticking](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-block-keeps-ticking) (keeps plants growing and other processes running even when chunks aren't loaded)

and much more.
